source: Add additional tanks as needed (stock tank 1 always stays). Do not switch senders onto the PCM FLI pin (false fill). Each extra tank needs its own Torque extra PID (MCU Mode 22, unique name — not 012F or Ford 16C1). Select-PID value is the 1-based tank id. Gal/hr is charged only to the active tank.

key:
Quick start
 1. Install Torque Pro (the paid version; Torque Lite does not support plugins) and pair your OBD-II adapter.
 2. Enable this plugin in Torque → Settings → Plugins.
 3. Allow notifications, and set battery use to Unrestricted so Torque can start this plugin in the background.
 4. In Torque, select the vehicle profile for the car you are driving. Data is kept per Torque profile and checked against the vehicle's VIN/ECU identity.
 5. On a new profile the fuel source is detected when you connect; if asked, compare it with your dash gauge and tap Confirm. Confirm is on the setup page and in the notification. You can also pick it below.
 6. There is no tank size to enter here. Each fit learns its own size, shown under Learned tank size; until then its corrected percent reads 1:1 with the gauge. Enter your tank size in the Torque vehicle profile for Torque's own remaining fuel and DTE.
 7. In Torque, add gauges for [FuelSmooth] Smoothed Fuel Level and each fit's Corrected % and Tank size. The plugin does not publish remaining fuel or DTE. A notice during a refit says that fit reads 1:1 until its refit finishes.
 8. Feed fuel level back to Torque: Off, Smoothed, or Corrected from the Chunk, Band or Kalman fit onto your 012F gauge. Torque's own fuel remaining and DTE then use that level with the tank size and long-term mpg in the Torque profile.
 9. Fuel is counted only while the engine runs. The plugin runs only while Torque is connected to the ECU.
 10. Keep driving and filling up; accuracy builds over several partial tanks. If the plugin cannot tell which vehicle this is, it asks in a notification and on this page; choose what to do with that drive.
 11. All data stays on this phone. No GPS or location is recorded.
source:
Quick start
 1. Install Torque Pro (the paid version; Torque Lite does not support plugins) and pair your OBD-II adapter.
 2. Enable this plugin in Torque → Settings → Plugins.
 3. Allow notifications, and set battery use to Unrestricted so Torque can start this plugin in the background.
 4. In Torque, select the vehicle profile for the car you are driving. Data is kept per Torque profile and checked against the vehicle's VIN/ECU identity.
 5. On a new profile the fuel source is detected when you connect; if asked, compare it with your dash gauge and tap Confirm. Confirm is on the setup page and in the notification. You can also pick it below.
 6. There is no tank size to enter here. Each fit learns its own size, shown under Learned tank size; until then its corrected percent reads 1:1 with the gauge. Enter your tank size in the Torque vehicle profile for Torque's own remaining fuel and DTE.
 7. In Torque, add gauges for [FuelSmooth] Smoothed Fuel Level and each fit's Corrected % and Tank size. The plugin does not publish remaining fuel or DTE. A notice during a refit says that fit reads 1:1 until its refit finishes.
 8. Feed fuel level back to Torque: Off, Smoothed, or Corrected from the Chunk, Band or Kalman fit onto your 012F gauge. Torque's own fuel remaining and DTE then use that level with the tank size and long-term mpg in the Torque profile.
 9. Fuel is counted only while the engine runs. The plugin runs only while Torque is connected to the ECU.
 10. Keep driving and filling up; accuracy builds over several partial tanks. If the plugin cannot tell which vehicle this is, it asks in a notification and on this page; choose what to do with that drive.
 11. All data stays on this phone. No GPS or location is recorded.
text:
Tòiseachadh luath
1. Stàlaich Torque Pro (an tionndadh pàighte; chan eil Torque Lite a' cur taic ri plugins) agus paidhrich an t-adapter OBD-II agad.
2. Cuir an plugin seo an comas ann an Torque → Roghainnean → Plugins.
3. Ceadaich brathan, agus cuir cleachdadh a' bhataraidh gu Gun bhacadh gus an urrainn do Torque an plugin seo a thòiseachadh sa chùlaibh.
4. Ann an Torque, tagh pròifil a' charbaid airson a' chàir a tha thu a' draibheadh. Thèid dàta a chumail a rèir pròifil Torque agus a dhearbhadh an aghaidh dearbh-aithne VIN/ECU a' charbaid.
5. Air pròifil ùr thèid tùs a' chonnaidh a lorg nuair a cheanglas tu; ma thèid faighneachd dhut, dèan coimeas ris a' mheatair air an deas-bhòrd agus gnog air Dearbhaich. Tha Dearbhaich air an duilleag shuidhichidh agus san fhios. Faodaidh tu cuideachd a thaghadh gu h-ìosal.
6. Chan eil meud tanca ri chur a-steach an seo. Ionnsaichidh gach freagarrachd a meud fhèin, air a shealltainn fo Mheud tanca ionnsaichte; gus an uairsin leughaidh a ceudad ceartaichte 1:1 leis a' mheatair. Cuir meud an tanca a-steach ann am pròifil carbaid Torque airson a' chonnaidh a tha air fhàgail agus DTE aig Torque fhèin.
7. Ann an Torque, cuir meatairean ris airson [FuelSmooth] Smoothed Fuel Level agus, airson gach freagarrachd, Corrected % agus Tank size. Chan fhoillsich am plugin connadh air fhàgail no DTE. Tha fios rè ath-fhreagarrachd ag ràdh gu bheil an fhreagarrachd sin a' leughadh 1:1 gus an crìochnaich an ath-fhreagarrachd.
8. Cuir ìre a' chonnaidh air ais gu Torque: Dheth, Rèidh no Ceartaichte on fhreagarrachd Chunk, Band no Kalman air a' mheatair 012F agad. Bidh connadh air fhàgail agus DTE aig Torque fhèin an uairsin a' cleachdadh na h-ìre sin leis a' mheud tanca agus an mpg fad-ùine ann am pròifil Torque.
9. Chan eil connadh air a chunntadh ach fhad 's a tha an t-einnsean a' ruith. Cha ruith an plugin ach fhad 's a tha Torque ceangailte ris an ECU.
10. Cùm a' draibheadh agus a' lìonadh; bidh an cruinneas a' fàs thar grunn thancaichean pàirteach. Mur urrainn don phlugan innse dè an carbad a tha seo, faighnichidh e ann am fios agus air an duilleag seo; tagh dè nì thu leis an draibh sin.
11. Fuirichidh an dàta air fad air an fhòn seo. Cha tèid GPS no ionad a chlàradh.
